table_description: Hotel management reporting table containing daily operational metrics, revenue data, occupancy statistics, and reservation information aggregated by business date, room class, and resort.

view_usage_notes.description: The View_Query_Example.sql demonstrates how REP_MANAGER data is aggregated for reporting. Key metrics calculated include:
view_usage_notes.calculation_approach: Data is aggregated by resort, with calculations for Today (TD), Month-to-Date (MTD), and Year-to-Date (YTD) periods. Currency conversion is applied using exchange rates.
